summary: Full backend+frontend verification iter160 for ARGUS NOC Alert Engine (Regole su metrica, Dipendenze padre→figli), Server-and-VMs NIC grouping and MAC history. Backend: both reference unit suites pass (test_alert_rules_iter160.py 4/4, test_mac_follow_iter154.py 13/13) and new HTTP integration suite /app/backend/tests/test_alert_engine_api_iter160.py 8/8 covering GET /api/alert-rules/metrics, full CRUD POST/PUT/DELETE /api/alert-rules with scope-validation 400s, POST /api/alert-rules/run, GET /api/alert-dependencies, merge-on-same-parent POST /api/alert-dependencies, 400 when child==parent, GET /api/alert-dependencies/suggestions, GET /api/clients/{cid}/nic-groups, 400 on invalid host IP for /nic-groups/host and shape of GET /api/devices/by-ip/{ip}/mac-history. Frontend: /settings/alert-engine shows alert-rules-panel and alert-dependencies-panel with all mandatory data-testids visible (rule-name/metric/operator/threshold/duration/severity/scope/create-btn, rules-run-now-btn, dep-client-select); created a rule via UI (TEST_iter160_ui_rule), it rendered rules-list + rule-row-<id> and rule-delete-<id>; rules-list / deps-list / dep-create-btn / dep-row-<id> are gated conditionally (only after rules exist / client selected) which matches design. For NIC grouping, seeded 3 managed_devices + /api/devices entries on preview client 86BIT_Office (da3d6e40…) sharing MAC 00:15:5d:ff:ee:01 and mac_history on host: UI showed 'Server e sue VM — Stessa scheda di rete' block (data-testid=nic-host-groups, nic-group-<mac>, badge '2 VM sulla stessa NIC', toggle, host-select pre-populated with physical host 10.231.0.12), children (TEST_SRV-VM1, TEST_SRV-VM2) rendered inside the collapsible group and NOT duplicated in other category groups (each IP appears exactly once across the 43-device grouped view). Changing host-select to 10.231.0.11 persisted (GET /api/.../nic-groups returned host_ip 10.231.0.11, host_manual true). Device info card (grouped-device-info-10.231.0.12) opened and rendered 'STORICO SCHEDE DI RETE (MAC)' section with mac-history-current (00:15:5D:FF:EE:01) and mac-history-list containing both history entries (01/11/25 10:00:00 and 05/01/26 12:34:56). Seed data cleaned up afterwards (managed_devices, devices, nic_hosts all deleted).
critical_code_review_comments: AlertRulesPanel renders rules-list only when rules.length>0 (otherwise rules-empty). Same for AlertDependenciesPanel: deps-list/dep-row-<id>/dep-create-btn/dep-children-list are mounted only after a client is selected. Expected behaviour but reviewer should note the testids listed in the request are not always present on first load — they appear after state transitions.
/api/alert-rules POST does not require admin for GET (list) but does for create/update/delete via require_admin — consistent and correct.

/api/alert-dependencies merge logic in POST sorts and dedupes child_ips, parent_ip excluded automatically — good. However duplicate dependency rows per (client, parent) are prevented by the merge path but there's no uniqueness index at the Mongo level: a race between two concurrent POSTs on the same parent could still create duplicates. Low priority.

nic_groups auto host proposition: picks virtualization='physical' first, otherwise most-frequent-name; falls back deterministically but no indication to admin in UI about which heuristic was used (just 'Server host (proposto)'). UX nit.

mac-history endpoint returns {current_mac:null, history:[], pending:null} with 200 when device not found instead of 404. Intentional (keeps UI simple) but may hide typos — document in API docs or add a `found: bool`.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all mandated testids rendered under expected conditions, host persistence verified, mac-history populated)

context_for_next_testing_agent: To exercise NIC grouping UI, you must seed BOTH collections (managed_devices for /api/clients/{cid}/nic-groups and devices collection with matching ip_address for /api/devices rendering) — see /app/backend/tests/seed_iter160_ui.py. In client/{cid} page, click [data-testid='tab-devices'] then the 'Tutti (N)' filter button to see all devices (otherwise 'Dispositivi Vitali' filter hides non-vital seeded ones). To bypass login rate-limit, prefer API login then localStorage.setItem('noc_token', <jwt>) before page.goto, as the browser-driven login hit 429 after a few quick attempts. The alert-engine testids rules-list / deps-list / dep-create-btn / dep-row-* / dep-children-list / rule-row-* are conditionally rendered — don't report them missing without first creating a rule / selecting a client.
